context: A teacher reassures a stressed student about cram school
purpose: Reassure a student; teach 塾/深夜/実力/選ば/起こっ/持た

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 塾に通い始めたそうですね。
lines.en: I hear you started going to cram school.
lines.style: attentive teacher opening gently, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、でも深夜まで続いて眠いです。
lines.en: Yes, but it runs until late night and I am sleepy.
lines.style: tired teen confiding her struggle, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 実力は少しずつ上がっていますよ。
lines.en: Your real ability is rising little by little.
lines.style: encouraging teacher noting her progress, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 推薦に選ばれるか不安で。
lines.en: I am anxious about being chosen for recommendation.
lines.style: worried teen voicing her fear, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 実力で選ばれる人は努力家です。
lines.en: Those chosen on ability are hard workers.
lines.style: affirming teacher validating effort, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、計算ミスが起こって落ち込みました。
lines.en: Yesterday a calculation error happened and I got down.
lines.style: discouraged teen sharing a setback, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 失敗が起こっても、見直せば大丈夫。
lines.en: Even if a mistake happens, reviewing it makes it fine.
lines.style: steady teacher reframing the error, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 自信を持たないとだめですね。
lines.en: I have to hold on to confidence, right?
lines.style: resolving teen gathering herself, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう、誇りを持たせる指導を心がけます。
lines.en: Yes, I aim to teach in a way that instills pride.
lines.style: devoted teacher pledging her support, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 塾の先生にも相談してみます。
lines.en: I will consult my cram-school teacher too.
lines.style: motivated teen taking initiative, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
